preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() != '' and line.strip().isdigit() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '0')
preconditions.description: Every non-empty line in stdin is a valid positive integer (digits only) except the terminating '0'.

preconditions.expression: all(int(line.strip()) > 61 and int(line.strip()) % 2 == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '0')
preconditions.description: Every input number (excluding '0') is an odd integer strictly greater than 61 and less than 10^6.
The input contains exactly one terminating '0' line.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip() == '0 0 0' or (len(stdout_line.strip().split()) == 3 and all(p.isdigit() for p in stdout_line.strip().split()))) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For each input number (excluding '0'), stdout contains either '0 0 0' or exactly three space-separated prime numbers.

postconditions.expression: all((int(p1) + int(p2)**2 + int(p3)**3 == int(input_num)) for input_num, stdout_line in zip([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '0'], stdout.splitlines()) if stdout_line.strip() != '0 0 0' and (p1, p2, p3) := stdout_line.strip().split())
postconditions.description: For every input number with a non-'0 0 0' output, the sum of the three primes (P1 + P2² + P3³) equals the input number.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip() == '0 0 0' or all(is_prime(int(p)) for p in stdout_line.strip().split())) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For every non-'0 0 0' output line, all three numbers are valid primes (2 ≤ p ≤ input_num).

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip() == '0 0 0' or (p1 := int(stdout_line.strip().split()[0])) >= 2 and (p2 := int(stdout_line.strip().split()[1])) >= 2 and (p3 := int(stdout_line.strip().split()[2])) >= 2) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For every non-'0 0 0' output line, all three primes are ≥ 2 (as primes cannot be 0, 1, or negative).
